project.name: Dremio Adapter
project.description:
The thin jar that actually wires Dremio OSS to everything else in this repo (plan Section 7, "Integration Points with Dremio OSS Core (no fork required)"). Compiled against dremio-oss's SPI interfaces and dropped onto the Dremio coordinator's classpath as a plugin — NOT deployed as its own service.
DELIBERATELY DOES NOT DEPEND ON QUARKUS. This jar's classes load inside Dremio's own coordinator JVM, sharing its classpath and dependency versions (Guava, Netty, Jackson, etc. — all pinned by dremio-oss's own BOM, which this module does not control). Pulling in Quarkus's dependency tree here risks classpath/version conflicts with Dremio's own libraries. Every other service in this repo is a separate deployable Quarkus reactive microservice; this one is not a service at all — it is a client of two of them (identity-access-service via gRPC, governance-lineage-service via plain HTTP), packaged to run inside a third party's process. See README for exactly how it's meant to be wired in.
IMPORTANT — read before treating the SPI interfaces here as real: dremio-oss is not published to Maven Central under consumable coordinates (its own artifacts, e.g. com.dremio:dremio-common, are only resolvable after building dremio-oss from source locally — see https://github.com/dremio/dremio-oss). This module therefore defines its own mirror interfaces under `spi/` shaped to match the plan's description of Dremio's actual AccessControlChecker/StoragePlugin SPI (Section 2, Section 7). Before deploying this adapter against a real Dremio OSS build, replace the `spi/` mirror interfaces' imports with the real `com.dremio.exec.store.*` / `com.dremio.exec.catalog.*` interfaces for your target dremio-oss version and adjust method signatures to match exactly — treat everything under `spi/` as a to-be-reconciled contract, not a verified one.
